Thanks for the interest — excited to run through a tailored demo for Novus Health. A quick note before we lock a slot: EU and US daylight-savings transitions fall on different weekends this year, so for about a week the usual offsets shift by an hour. That has tripped up a couple of cross-region invites recently.

To avoid any confusion, can you confirm whether you prefer:
- Option A: Tue Nov 4, 09:00 CET (Redwood demo + Q&A, ~45m) — this is after both regions have settled back to standard time.
- Option B: Wed Nov 5, 16:00 CET (more friendly for APAC colleagues to join late afternoon CET).

If neither works, tell me a couple of windows and I will send an ICS that pins the timezone for everyone. Ill loop in Laura from Solutions if we need APAC follow-up.

Cheers,
